scientific_integrity: No independent audit has been performed. The proof covers both real and complex Banach spaces; examples are not extrapolated to establish infinite-dimensional conclusions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to two-dimensional operator pencils, with no uniform numerical detection bound or higher-dimensional conclusion. Priority under unsearched older terminology remains possible; finite checks supplement the proof.
title: The sharp rank-two spectral test for every two-dimensional operator pencil
